'''Jeremy Levy''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Levy was born on May 7, 1981, and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where he voiced {{an|Lillie}}'s father [[Mohn]] and [[Charlie Charma]]. He currently lives in New York City. In 2021, Levy married fellow Pokémon Voice Actor [[Lauren Kammerling]].
